subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should the extension relay intentionally treat an omitted Target.createTarget background value as background automation intent, despite upstream CDP defaulting the omitted value to foreground creation?
rationale: Source and tests establish a correct implementation, but code inspection cannot decide whether compatibility with transparent CDP defaults or non-disruptive OpenClaw automation is the intended permanent relay contract.

options.title: Accept automation default
options.body: Keep the patch's omitted-parameter behavior because OpenClaw and Playwright automation should not activate shared browser UI unless focus is explicit.

options.title: Preserve CDP default
options.body: Keep omitted relay requests foreground-compatible and introduce a separate internal mechanism for OpenClaw background creation.

recommendation.title: Accept automation default
recommendation.body: Keep the patch's omitted-parameter behavior because OpenClaw and Playwright automation should not activate shared browser UI unless focus is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same browser/CDP focus surface provides the strongest available history signal for this contract decision.
